en: Atītānāgatavāra (The Section on the Past and Future)
Is it the case that whoever has fully understood the truth of suffering will abandon the truth of the origin? No.
Or rather, is it the case that whoever will abandon the truth of the origin has fully understood the truth of suffering? No.
Is it the case that whoever has not fully understood the truth of suffering will not abandon the truth of the origin?
Those who will attain the path have not fully understood the truth of suffering, yet they will not fail to abandon the truth of the origin.
Those who possess the supreme path and those worldlings who will not attain the path have neither fully understood the truth of suffering nor will they abandon the truth of the origin.
Or again, whoever will not abandon the truth of the origin will not have fully understood the truth of suffering?
An Arahant will not abandon the truth of the origin, yet he has not failed to fully understand the truth of suffering.
One who possesses the supreme path and those worldlings who will not attain the path will neither abandon the truth of the origin nor have fully understood the truth of suffering.
The Manual of the Truth-Pairing is finished.
